description: The plot titled “BBQ” illustrates how accuracy varies with the number of demonstrations for four methods. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 1500 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, and 1500. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels at 45, 50, and 55 (with the plotted values extending slightly above 55). A dark navy solid line with circular markers labeled “Squared-Exponential” starts near 53 at the smallest demonstration count, rises to about 56 by roughly 250 demonstrations, and then stays near 56 through 1500 demonstrations with small fluctuations (around 56–56.5). A medium-blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Tanh” stays close to 48 across the x-axis, beginning around 48 near the smallest demonstration count and ending around 48 at 1500 with a slight dip around the mid-range. A light lavender solid line with circular markers labeled “ELU” remains nearly flat around 46–46.5 from the smallest demonstration count through 1500. A pink dashed horizontal line labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” is constant across all x-values at approximately 43.
